newsitem.title: USA: ADAC to take $5.9 mln charge in Q3.
newsitem.headline: ADAC to take $5.9 mln charge in Q3.

text.p: ADAC Laboratories Inc said Friday it would take a $5.9 million pre-tax charge in the quarter ended June 30 to account for its buying private Cortet Inc of Winter Park, Fla.
ADAC said the one-time charge relates to its buying in-process research and developement and acquistition expenses.

The company said it issued about 159,000 ADAC shares to Cortet shareholders and paid closing costs and related expenses. It said it completed the acquistion of the developer of client-server computer systems Friday.

ADAC posted a net income of $4.4 million, or $0.24 a share, in the quarter ended June 30 1996. An April 24 First Call consensus estimate of nine brokers put the company's earnings at $0.30 a share for the current quarter.
The company's stock traded unchanged at 23-1/8 Friday morning.
